article.body: New research on the potential for AI to destabilize societies is out.  "Financial Fragility in Societies of LLM Agents: Coordination Failures and Stabilizing Mechanisms" explores how large language models could disrupt financial systems.  The authors warn of potential coordination failures and propose stabilizing mechanisms.  The research is based on a paper published on arXiv.  The authors haven't yet provided independent verification, but the paper does offer a detailed exploration of the potential risks.
